_comment: File list for the Pygbag 0.9.3 CPython-WASM runtime that games/flappybirb depends on.
This CDN tree is a GitHub Pages build artifact and exists in no git repo, so the list was
derived by reading pythons.js: it resolves config.cdn from its own script URL (line ~2353),
then loads `${interpreter}${pydigits}/main.js` — cpython312/ for a data-python=python3.12
build. Emscripten's main.js then pulls main.wasm and main.data as siblings.
Everything else main.js references is a virtual-FS path inside main.data, not a fetch.
Note vtx.js and lib/index.html sit one level ABOVE the version directory (cdn/, not
cdn/0.9.3/) — vtx.js is pulled because the game's shell sets data-os="vtx,snd,gui".
Re-derive with: curl .../pythons.js and re-read the config.cdn / config.executable logic.
Deliberately NOT listed: browserfs.min.js, which the game's index.html requests but which
404s on the live site too (its 9379-byte response is the GitHub Pages 404 page). The game
works without it, so the offline copy reproduces that same harmless miss.
Also not listed: pygbag0.9.3.js — its service-worker registration is commented out upstream.
